events.title: Welcome to the Steam Danmaku Festival!
events.summary: We’re excited to be part of the Steam Danmaku Festival! If you love chaotic action, endless enemy waves, crazy builds, and satisfying destruction, we hope you’ll enjoy trying out our game during the festival.Thank you for checking it out, and have fun blasting through hordes of enemies! Your feedback and support mean a lot to us.Enjoy the festival and happy surviving!

events.title: Sound and gameplay update
events.summary: Hey everyone, based on your feedback we just released a small patch: Gameplay -Thavok has been toned down even more: -Shoots less projectiles -HP reduced by 10 %-defeating bosses now spawns dandelions as reward (10 for miniboss, 50 for final boss) -armor increased in Standard Mode Sound -We introduce 4 new songs made by LasseLou

events.title: Ophelia´s Paradise fully supported on Steam Deck
events.summary: We are excited to announce: The game now fully supports steam deck and is optimized for it! Give it a try and let us know your feedback!

events.title: Community Patch – Stability & QoL Improvements
events.summary: Camera stabilized, smarter flower spawns, and a confirmation prompt before ending your run. Thank you for your amazing feedback!- Fixed the camera bugging out- Prevented flowers from spawning too close to the edge- Added a confirmation prompt when returning to the Main Menu mid-run

Equip them in the Forge to shape your long-term progression and customize future runs.The entire user interface has been overhauled for better clarity, flow, and usability across the game.Performance got a big upgrade too.
